title: Seceda & the Dolomites
route: Brescia → Ortisei → Seceda → Sella Ronda → Selva di Val Gardena
introTitle: Into the heart of the Dolomites.
intro: Leave Brescia around 6:30–7:00 AM for Ortisei, ride the Seceda cableways for about an hour of ridgeline photography, and enjoy lunch in town. Aim to start the Sella Ronda drive by 1:00 PM. The four-pass loop is optional: protect the most important stop, Passo Gardena, by arriving around 4:15 PM for golden-hour light. If still at Passo Sella at 2:00 PM, skip the remaining loop and head via Selva directly to Passo Gardena. Road and lift conditions may require adjustments.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Leave Brescia around 6:30–7:00 AM. Aim to park at the Seceda cableways in Ortisei around 9:30–10:00 AM.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Arrive in Ortisei, park and ride the cableways to Seceda. Allow time for boarding and descent; target lunch in Ortisei around noon.

stops.name: Seceda
stops.description: Prioritize about an hour photographing the iconic Odle ridgeline. Descend in time for lunch rather than racing through the afternoon.

stops.name: Seceda Cableways — Ortisei
stops.description: Lunch in Ortisei approximately noon–1:00 PM. Aim to leave by 1:00 PM (latest 1:15 PM) to begin the scenic drive.

stops.name: Passo Sella
stops.description: First mountain-pass photo stop. Decision cutoff: leave Passo Sella by 2:00 PM to attempt the full loop. If still here at 2:00 PM, skip Pordoi, Arabba and Campolongo; return via Selva toward Passo Gardena.

stops.name: Passo Pordoi
stops.description: Optional if ahead of schedule. Leave Passo Pordoi by 3:00 PM; otherwise make no extended photography stops on the remaining loop.

stops.name: Arabba
stops.description: Drive through Arabba without a long stop if the clock is running late.

stops.name: Passo Campolongo
stops.description: Optional pass on the full Sella Ronda loop. Keep moving if running behind.

stops.name: Corvara
stops.description: Aim to leave Corvara by 3:45 PM; no further sightseeing stops before Passo Gardena.

stops.name: Passo Gardena
stops.description: THE PHOTO PRIORITY: arrive by approximately 4:15 PM, preferably earlier, to capture late-afternoon and golden-hour light. Mountain shadows can arrive before sunset.

stops.name: Selva di Val Gardena
stops.description: Descend to your hotel in Selva di Val Gardena after Passo Gardena. Allow extra time for mountain roads and changing weather.
